# Robert Kirby

[Economics · Finance · Business Analytics & Information Systems]{.tagline}

I'm a senior at Xavier University completing a triple major in Economics, Finance, and Business Analytics & Information Systems. I work with data end to end: collecting it, checking it, modelling it, and explaining what it means in plain language. This site collects my projects, both finished work with full code and write-ups and projects that are in progress.
